title: Past perfect continuous (I had been doing)

lesson.summary:
Past perfect continuous dibentuk dengan *had been + V-ing*. Bentuk ini dipakai untuk aktivitas yang sudah berlangsung sampai suatu titik di masa lalu. Bisa juga aktivitas yang baru berhenti sebelum titik itu dan hasilnya masih terlihat: *The ground was wet. It had been raining.*

Bentuk ini sering dipakai dengan *how long, for, since* untuk menyatakan durasi sampai titik di masa lalu: *We had been waiting for an hour when the bus finally came.*

Bandingkan tiga bentuk ini. *have been doing* berpatokan pada sekarang. *had been doing* berpatokan pada masa lalu. *was doing* hanya berarti sedang berlangsung pada saat itu, tanpa keterangan sudah berapa lama. Jadi *We were talking when the teacher came in* benar. Tetapi kalau ada *for ten minutes*, bentuknya *We had been talking for ten minutes when the teacher came in.*

Kata kerja keadaan (*know, like, want*) tetap memakai past perfect simple: *I had known him for years* (bukan *had been knowing*).

patterns.formula: had been + V-ing + for … when + past simple
patterns.example: We had been waiting for an hour when it came.

patterns.formula: How long + had + subjek + been + V-ing … ?
patterns.example: How long had you been looking for a job?
I had known him for years.

examples.en: The ground was wet. It had been raining.
We had been waiting for an hour when the bus finally came.
examples.id: Kami sudah menunggu sejam waktu busnya akhirnya datang.

examples.en: Her eyes were red because she had been crying.
He had been living in Japan for five years before he moved back to Indonesia.
examples.id: Dia sudah tinggal di Jepang lima tahun sebelum pindah kembali ke Indonesia.

examples.en: The children were dirty because they had been playing in the garden.
examples.id: Anak-anak kotor karena habis bermain di kebun.

examples.en: I had known him for years before we became friends.
examples.id: Saya sudah lama kenal dia sebelum kami berteman.

commonMistakes.wrong: She was tired because she has been studying all night.
commonMistakes.right: She was tired because she had been studying all night.
commonMistakes.why: Patokannya masa lalu (*was*), jadi pakai *had been*.

commonMistakes.wrong: He had been knowing her for years.
commonMistakes.right: He had known her for years.

commonMistakes.wrong: I was waiting for two hours when she called.
commonMistakes.right: I had been waiting for two hours when she called.
commonMistakes.why: Durasi sampai titik di masa lalu (*for two hours*) memakai *had been + V-ing*.

Patokannya masa lalu (woke up, were), jadi pakai had.

questions.sentence: Rudi was out of breath. He ___.

options.why: Benar. Penyebab napas terengah-engah saat itu.
Patokannya masa lalu (was), jadi pakai had.

questions.explanation: Penyebab keadaan di masa lalu: had been + V-ing.

options.why: Benar. for ten minutes = durasi sampai guru masuk.
were talking benar tanpa for ten minutes, tetapi durasi sampai titik di masa lalu butuh had been + V-ing.
